text: Jordan had a productive evening at Groundwork, cracking a design problem for Coda's "free play" mode—recording sessions with tappable timestamps that can later be annotated and clipped into an organized library—and built a working prototype in about ninety minutes, feeling confident Dev will like it. Mika stopped by and Jordan agreed readily to plan another open mic, which surprised them both, and Mika noted Jordan seems different lately. Jordan felt genuinely good afterward, reflecting that work stress is just one thread among many—Coda, Dev, Mika, music, Pepper, the apartment, the park—rather than the whole picture.
